findings.title: UsernameForm calls a method that does not exist
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate now calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only method added on UsernamePasswordForm is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel). Nothing in the hierarchy defines a no-arg overload, so this class does not compile and the re-authentication skip change cannot be built or deployed.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys no longer set up when the user is unknown
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled requires a non-null user, and both authenticate() and the error challenge() now call fillContextForm only through that helper. Previously webauthn/passkey form data was filled when the user was not yet selected, which is the conditional-UI login path. With this change, the first username/password (and username-only) page omits the challenge, RP ID, and conditional-UI flag whenever context.getUser() is null, so discoverable passkey login on the initial form no longer works. Re-authentication (user already set) is the only path that still gets passkey data. The existing tests that expect //form[@id='webauth'] on the first login page will fail.
